source.name: Arab News - Dakar Rally Saudi Arabia 2027 route unveiled
source.note: Route launch 'under the supervision of the Ministry of Sport'. dakar.com partners page lists the Ministry of Sport (mos.gov.sa) as an institutional partner; mos.gov.sa did not load on 25 Sep 2026.
